recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source fix that aligns search.html with the published Jira resolution and the already-correct HTTP page without reopening the separately reconciled FHIR-38993 terminology work.
issue_request: FHIR-35859 was Published/Persuasive and asked for POST-based search to be fully defined like GET search, including server-wide [base]/_search and compartment [base]/[compartment]/[id]/_search interactions in HTTP summary tables and search.html documentation/examples.
initial_application: Git commit 7415a1eb0824ba59d977db335205d71eed004312 applied most of the issue by adding server-root, typed, compartment, and compartment-plus-type POST examples to source/http.html and adding REST summary rows for search-system/search-compartment. It also added server-root and typed compartment POST examples to source/search.html, but left the all-resource compartment POST example absent from that Search page context section.
additional_context: Current source/http.html already documents POST [base]/_search, POST [base]/[compartment-type]/[compartment-id]/_search, POST [base]/[compartment-type]/[compartment-id]/[resource-type]/_search, and the matching search-system/search-compartment summary rows. The Search page is the active narrative source linked from the HTTP page for search contexts, so it needed to show the same all-resource compartment POST form. A Zulip thread from the original application raised the related search-compartment RESTful-interaction terminology question, and the later FHIR-38993 reconciliation already handled that terminology issue on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html so the compartment search context is explicitly 'with or without' a resource type and the GET/POST examples show both GET [base]/[compartment]/[id]/*, GET [base]/[compartment]/[id]/[type], POST [base]/[compartment]/[id]/_search, and POST [base]/[compartment]/[id]/[type]/_search.
source_changes: source/search.html: clarified that compartment searches may be with or without a resource type.
source/search.html: added all-resource compartment GET and POST examples, including POST [base]/[compartment]/[id]/_search, next to the typed compartment examples.

related_jiras.note: The historical source commit that applied FHIR-35859 also applied FHIR-37822 HTTP header work; this reconciliation touched only the FHIR-35859 search documentation gap.
FHIR-35859's application exposed the missing search-compartment RESTful-interaction terminology, later tracked as FHIR-38993 and already represented on the combined branch.
